description: Generic tapered plate with a top hook and one slot. A sample for the photo-to-part workflow, not a commercial part.

parameter_help.height_mm: Plate height, not counting the hook.
parameter_help.hook_lip_mm: Thickness of the hook's left bar and top lip.
parameter_help.hook_overlap_mm: How far the hook digs into the plate so the union is not a kiss.
parameter_help.hook_rise_mm: How far the hook rises above the plate.
parameter_help.hook_width_mm: How far the hook extends in from the left edge.
parameter_help.lower_taper_mm: Inset of each bottom corner. Zero is a straight plate.
parameter_help.slot_center_x_mm: Slot center, from the left edge.
parameter_help.slot_center_y_mm: Slot center, from the bottom edge.
parameter_help.width_mm: Overall width across the top of the plate.
